x: It was unfortunate that in this event Robin Tolson was unable to overcome an early season injury, and was never able to race. John Sams has done virtually nothing hurdlewise, except the Sward, but Pat Fox ran one or two reasonable 440's as second string to Charlie Jones.
High hurdler, R. Tolson, battled with his opponents against a near gale-force wind to gain fifth place in both the high and low hurdle events, recording 16.2 and 27.0 respectively.
Jack still has 1½ yrs to improve on this time. July R.T.
120 yds. hurdles · R. T. Tolson · 7/1960 · 15.3 secs.
